# Contributing Guidelines

Thank you for contributing! To keep this project legally safe and easy to maintain, we enforce the **Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO)**.

## Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO)
By contributing to this project, you agree that your contribution is open-source under the project's license and that you have the right to submit it.

To certify your work, add a `Signed-off-by` line to every git commit message:

\`\`\`bash
git commit -s -m "feat: your descriptive commit message"
\`\`\`

Pull requests missing DCO sign-offs will fail automated CI checks.
